title: Atlantic City film and television years he cannot recall
summary: Nierenberg tries Steve Allen, Perry Como and an Atlantic City film; Bubbles remembers none of them.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Yeah, during that time. You haven't got much of it have you?
You haven't gotten much of Steve Allen, you haven't got Perry Como --
Those are television years. We're still back in the 1930s now we're going to the '40s, as long as you're doing the films, we might as well go into Atlantic City. I take it it wasn't much.
Doesn't ring no bell, doesn't ring no bell. (Unintelligible)
Do you remember what that was about?
No, unless I saw something from it. Sorry.
Okay. I find it somewhat surprising that these films don't stand out in your mind, but perhaps it's because the films didn't have as much meaning to you as performing live on stage.
